description: Na₃Pr(AsO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.91 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.60 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.71 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.86 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent Pr sites. In the first Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-3.01 Å. In the second Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.99 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-69°. There is one shorter (1.71 Å) and three longer (1.73 Å) As-O bond lengths. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-38°. All As-O bond lengths are 1.72 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-38°. There are three shorter (1.72 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) As-O bond length. In the fourth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-68°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.74 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one As atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃As tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Pr, and one As atom to form distorted ONa₂PrAs tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₃As tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₂PrAs trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one As atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃As tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pr, and one As atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pr, and one As atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Pr, and one As atom to form distorted ONa₂PrAs tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₃As tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂PrAs trigonal pyramid. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Pr, and one As atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Pr, and one As atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂PrAs trigonal pyramids.
